name: findcheap-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog and an approved Awin Feed, find verified deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.9.5 separates objective must-have specifications from subjective preferences, supports product types plus Chinese and English material, shoe, and style synonyms, and evaluates evidence across titles, categories, descriptions, and structured variants. Explicit contradictions are excluded; missing evidence remains a clearly limited DISCOVERY_MATCH instead of becoming a false zero result. Every installation can access approved Awin products through a public, read-only, rate-limited Railway Search API while Feed URLs and service secrets stay private. Search responses remain limited to validated merchants and three products. It never infers product condition or manufacturer authorization, excludes risky domains, and keeps commercial relationships out of relevance and ranking. Delivered-price follow-ups obey each card's quote capability. Authorized Chrome remains a bounded fallback after API search returns no usable product. The agent never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Clear shopping request: call matching tool now. No Memory, repo scan, plan narration, or manual MCP launch.
